title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Nvidia's stock is rising on investor confidence as AI demand expands beyond major cloud providers, highlighted by Dell's earnings report.
Markets: Snowflake's stock surged after it exceeded estimates with a strong AI-driven revenue forecast reflecting growing demand for AI data tools.
Markets: Broadcom shares dropped over 5% due to weak revenue guidance for the current quarter despite beating earnings expectations.
Markets: Palantir's stock declined following a post-earnings rally, pressured by rising bond yields and competitive dynamics influenced by Google.

Companies: The Los Angeles Clippers were fined $30 million, and owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year, with the team forfeiting five first-round draft picks starting in 2029 due to salary cap violations.
Companies: Microsoft will begin reporting Azure quarterly revenue figures in dollars, enhancing transparency for its cloud business competing with AWS.
Companies: Ford's production of Super Duty trucks reached a 20-year high amid ongoing U.S. new vehicle sales declines for eight consecutive months as it recovers from supplier disruptions.
Macro/Policy: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to its highest level since November 2023, driven by inflation concerns and robust economic outlooks noted by New York Fed President John Williams.
